enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Pull the quilt up to the shoulders. Place head on the pillow. Close eyes. Turn body to the left side. Pull the quilt with the left hand. Turn body to the right side. Stretch both legs. Move the right arm under the pillow. Turn face toward the wall. Pull the quilt up again. Keep the body still. Breathe slowly. Turn to the back. Place both hands on the quilt. Remain lying without moving until 07:00.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and taking a shower
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up on the bed. Swing both legs to the floor. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Step inside. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the water heater switch. Open the shower tap. Hold the right hand under the water. Adjust the tap handle to the left. Take off the pajama top. Take off the pajama pants. Step under the shower head. Wet hair and body. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the left palm. Rub shampoo into the hair. Rinse hair under the water. Pick up the soap. Rub soap on the arms, chest, and legs. Rinse the body. Turn off the shower tap. Pick up the towel from the hook. Wipe the hair with the towel. Wipe the face. Wipe the arms and legs. Wrap the towel around the body. Step out of the shower area. Turn off the bathroom light. Open the door. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling water with the kettle, toasting bread, and eating breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Open the cabinet door. Take out the kettle. Place the kettle on the counter. Open the tap. Fill the kettle with water. Close the tap. Place the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch down. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the bread and a carton of milk. Close the refrigerator door. Take out two slices of bread. Place the slices into the toaster. Push the toaster lever down. Open the cabinet door. Take out a cup and a plate. Place the cup on the counter. Place the plate on the counter. Open the drawer. Take out a butter knife. Close the drawer. Open the refrigerator door again. Take out the butter. Close the refrigerator door. Open the butter lid. Cut a piece of butter with the knife. Spread butter on the toasted bread. Place the bread on the plate. Pick up the cup. Pour hot water from the kettle into the cup. Put the cup down. Pull out the chair. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the bread. Take a bite. Chew and swallow. Take another bite. Drink water from the cup. Pick up the plate. Finish the bread. Drink the rest of the water. Stand up. Push the chair back under the table. Carry the plate and cup to the sink. Place them in the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the plate and cup. Turn off the tap.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing morning chores, tidying up and vacuuming the floor
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Pick up the cushion from the sofa. Place the cushion on the armrest. Pick up the TV remote from the coffee table. Place the remote on the shelf. Pick up the magazines on the table. Stack the magazines. Place the stack on the shelf. Pick up the empty cup on the table. Carry the cup to the kitchen counter. Walk back to the living room. Turn on the living room light. Open the storage closet door. Take out the vacuum cleaner. Close the closet door. Pull the vacuum cord. Plug the cord into the wall socket. Press the vacuum power button. Push the vacuum across the floor. Pull the vacuum back. Move the vacuum under the coffee table. Move the vacuum along the sofa edge. Push the vacuum toward the corner. Pull the vacuum along the wall. Press the power button to stop the vacuum. Unplug the cord. Wind the cord around the hook. Open the closet door. Place the vacuum inside. Close the closet door. Turn off the living room light.

enriched_activities.activity: Grocery shopping and running errands around the neighborhood
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the entryway. Open the shoe cabinet. Take out the shoes. Put on the shoes. Tie the shoelaces. Pick up the tote bag from the hook. Open the door. Step outside. Close the door. Walk down the stairs. Walk along the sidewalk. Stop at the crosswalk. Press the pedestrian button. Wait for the signal. Cross the street. Walk to the grocery store entrance. Push the glass door open. Pick up a shopping basket. Walk down the aisle. Pick up a bag of rice. Place it in the basket. Pick up a bottle of cooking oil. Place it in the basket. Pick up a carton of eggs. Place it in the basket. Pick up vegetables. Place them in the basket. Walk to the checkout counter. Place the basket on the counter. Take out the wallet. Hand the card to the cashier. Take the card back. Place the items into the tote bag. Lift the tote bag. Walk out of the store. Walk to the pharmacy. Open the door. Ask the staff for the prescription pickup. Wait at the counter. Take the paper bag. Pay with the card. Walk out. Walk to the post office. Open the door. Take a number ticket. Wait in line. Hand the parcel to the clerk. Pay the fee. Take the receipt. Walk out. Walk back along the sidewalk. Cross the street at the crosswalk. Walk up the stairs. Open the door. Step inside. Close the door. Put the tote bag on the kitchen counter. Take off the shoes. Place the shoes in the shoe cabinet.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating lunch at home
enriched_activities.desc: Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables and eggs. Close the refrigerator door. Place the vegetables on the cutting board. Open the drawer. Take out a knife. Close the drawer. Hold the knife in the right hand. Cut the vegetables into pieces. Place the pieces into a bowl. Put the knife down. Pick up an egg. Crack the egg on the bowl edge. Pour the egg into the bowl. Pick up the whisk. Beat the eggs. Put the whisk down. Turn on the range hood. Press the induction cooker power button. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Add the vegetables. Stir with the spatula. Add the egg mixture. Stir again. Press the power button to turn off the induction cooker. Pick up the plate. Scoop the food onto the plate. Carry the plate to the table. Pull out the chair. Sit down. Pick up the chopsticks. Pick up food. Eat the food. Chew and swallow. Drink water from the cup. Finish the food. Stand up. Pick up the plate and chopsticks. Carry them to the sink. Place them in the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the plate and chopsticks. Turn off the tap. Turn off the range hood.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the sofa. Sit down on the sofa. Lean back against the cushion. Pick up the TV remote from the shelf. Point the remote at the TV. Press the power button. Press the channel button. Place the remote on the sofa armrest. Pick up the cushion. Place the cushion behind the back. Cross the legs. Watch the screen. Pick up the remote again. Press the volume button. Put the remote down. Adjust the sitting position. Stretch the arms. Place both hands on the lap. Watch the screen. Pick up the remote. Press the power button to turn the TV off. Place the remote on the armrest. Stand up from the sofa.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a leisurely walk in the local park
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the entryway. Put on the shoes. Tie the shoelaces. Open the door. Step outside. Close the door. Walk down the stairs. Walk along the sidewalk. Turn left at the corner. Walk to the park gate. Step through the gate. Walk along the paved path. Pass the bench. Walk around the pond. Stop at the railing. Place both hands on the railing. Look at the water. Turn around. Walk along the path. Cross the small bridge. Walk past the playground. Step onto the grass edge. Walk back to the main path. Walk toward the park gate. Step out of the gate. Walk back along the sidewalk. Turn right at the corner. Walk up the stairs. Open the door. Step inside. Close the door. Take off the shoes. Place the shoes in the shoe cabinet.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV with the air conditioner on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Pick up the air conditioner remote from the shelf. Point the remote at the air conditioner. Press the power button. Press the temperature button. Place the remote on the shelf. Walk to the sofa. Sit down on the sofa. Lean back. Pick up the TV remote. Press the TV power button. Press the channel button. Put the remote on the armrest. Watch the screen. Cross the legs. Adjust the cushion behind the back. Pick up the remote. Press the volume button. Put the remote down. Stretch the arms. Place hands on the lap. Watch the screen. Pick up the remote. Press the power button to turn the TV off. Pick up the air conditioner remote. Press the power button to turn the air conditioner off. Place the remote on the shelf. Stand up from the sofa.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer and desk lamp to plan upcoming community programs and answer emails
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bedroom door. Push the door open. Step inside. Walk to the desk. Pull out the chair. Sit down. Turn on the desk lamp switch. Press the computer power button. Wait for the screen to light up. Move the mouse. Click the email icon. Open the inbox. Read the first email. Place both hands on the keyboard. Type a reply. Click the send button. Open the next email. Read it. Type a reply. Click the send button. Open the calendar. Click on the date cell. Type the program name. Click the save button. Open the document file. Scroll down with the mouse. Type paragraphs of the plan. Click the save button. Open a new email. Type the recipient address. Type the subject line. Type the message body. Click the send button. Pick up the phone. Press the phone power button. Open the message app. Type a message. Press the send button. Put the phone on the desk. Turn the head toward the screen. Scroll the document again. Type more notes. Click the save button. Move the mouse to the shutdown menu. Click shut down. Wait for the screen to turn off. Press the desk lamp switch off. Stand up. Push the chair under the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating dinner using the induction cooker and oven
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the meat, vegetables, and a bowl of rice. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Open the drawer. Take out a knife and a cutting board. Place the cutting board on the counter. Cut the meat into pieces. Cut the vegetables into pieces. Put the knife down. Turn on the range hood. Press the induction cooker power button. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Add the meat. Stir with the spatula. Add the vegetables. Pour sauce into the pan. Stir again. Press the power button to turn off the induction cooker. Press the oven power button. Open the oven door. Place the tray with the food inside. Close the oven door. Press the timer button. Wait for the oven timer to beep. Press the oven power button off. Open the oven door. Take out the tray. Place the tray on the counter. Pick up the plate. Scoop the food onto the plate. Carry the plate to the table. Pull out the chair. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the chopsticks. Pick up the food. Eat the food. Chew and swallow. Drink water from the cup. Finish the food. Stand up. Pick up the plate and chopsticks. Carry them to the sink. Place them in the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the plate and chopsticks. Turn off the tap. Turn off the range hood. Turn off the kitchen light.

Walk into the living room. Turn on the living room light. Walk to the sofa. Sit down. Lean back against the cushion. Pick up the TV remote from the armrest. Point the remote at the TV. Press the power button. Press the channel button. Put the remote on the armrest. Watch the screen. Cross the legs. Pick up the remote. Press the volume button. Put the remote down. Adjust the sitting position. Place both hands on the lap. Pick up the phone from the pocket. Press the phone power button. Look at the screen. Press the phone power button off. Put the phone on the sofa. Watch the screen again. Pick up the remote. Press the power button to turn the TV off. Stand up. Turn off the living room light.

enriched_activities.activity: Playing video games on the game console
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the TV stand. Press the game console power button. Pick up the controller from the shelf. Sit down on the sofa. Lean back against the cushion. Hold the controller with both hands. Press the start button. Select the game on the screen. Press the confirm button. Press the control buttons with the thumbs. Press the trigger buttons with the index fingers. Tilt the controller. Press the pause button. Put the controller on the lap. Pick up the cup from the table. Drink water. Put the cup down. Pick up the controller again. Press the control buttons. Press the menu button. Select the next level. Press the confirm button. Continue pressing the buttons. Press the pause button. Stand up. Walk to the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out a bottle of water. Close the refrigerator door. Walk back to the sofa. Sit down. Open the bottle cap. Drink water. Close the bottle cap. Put the bottle on the table. Pick up the controller. Press the buttons again. Press the pause button. Press the exit button. Press the console power button off. Place the controller on the shelf. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Brushing teeth and washing up before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Step inside. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the water heater switch. Turn on the tap. Wet the toothbrush under the water. Turn off the tap. Open the toothpaste tube. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Close the toothpaste tube. Put the toothbrush into the mouth. Brush the upper teeth. Brush the lower teeth. Spit into the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the mouth with water. Turn off the tap. Rinse the toothbrush under the water. Place the toothbrush in the holder. Place the toothpaste tube on the shelf. Turn on the tap. Wet both hands. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap on the hands. Rinse the hands. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face. Wipe the hands. Hang the towel on the hook. Turn off the water heater switch. Turn off the bathroom light. Open the door. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and browsing the phone with the fan on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bedroom. Press the fan power button. Press the fan speed button. Walk to the bed. Sit down on the bed. Pick up the book from the nightstand. Open the book to the bookmark. Read the page. Turn the page with the right hand. Read the next page. Turn the page again. Close the book. Place the book on the nightstand. Pick up the phone from the nightstand. Press the phone power button. Swipe the screen. Open the message app. Scroll the list. Tap a message. Type a reply. Press the send button. Press the back button. Open the news app. Scroll the page. Tap an article. Scroll down. Press the back button. Press the phone power button off. Place the phone on the nightstand. Pull the quilt up. Lie down on the bed. Place the head on the pillow.

Lie on the bed. Pull the quilt up to the shoulders. Place the head on the pillow. Close the eyes. Turn to the right side. Pull the quilt with the left hand. Turn to the left side. Stretch both legs. Place the right arm under the pillow. Turn to the back. Place both hands on the quilt. Keep the body still. Remain lying without moving until 24:00.
